# Site Builder Reference

For creating and maintaining a site with CfA Static. Regenerate with `npm run generate-references`, or `npm run generate-developer-reference` for this file alone.

## Runtime And Commands

Use Node `>=22.15` and npm. Install dependencies from the repository root:

```sh
npm install
```

Selected site-building commands from [package.json](../package.json). See [verification](../skills/cfa-static-site-builder/references/verification.md) for which checks to run.

| Command | Package Script |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run serve` | `rm -rf _site && node scripts/eleventy-build.js --serve --incremental` |
| `npm run build` | `rm -rf _site && node scripts/eleventy-build.js && npm run check:links` |
| `npm run customise-cms` | `node scripts/customise-cms/index.js` |
| `npm run check:links` | `node scripts/check-internal-links.js _site` |
| `npm run check:a11y` | `node scripts/check-accessibility.js _site` |
| `npm run lint:scss` | `npx stylelint "src/css/**/*.scss"` |
| `npm run test` | `node ./test/run-tests.js` |
| `npm run generate-references` | `npm run generate-blocks-reference && npm run generate-pages-yml && npm run generate-developer-reference` |

## CMS Choices

These are available editor options, not this site's saved selection. CMS collection choices do not control what Eleventy publishes. See [project setup](../skills/cfa-static-site-builder/references/project-setup.md#choose-collections-and-cms-features) before changing them.

| Collection | Content Directory | Availability | Depends On |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | `src/pages` | Required | None |
| `news` | `src/news` | Optional | None |
| `guide-categories` | `src/guide-categories` | Optional | None |
| `guide-pages` | `src/guide-pages` | Optional | `guide-categories` |
| `snippets` | `src/snippets` | Required | None |

| Feature | Editor Choice |
| --- | --- |
| `permalinks` | Do you want custom permalinks on items? |
| `redirects` | Do you want redirect\_from support (for URL redirects)? |
| `faqs` | Do you want FAQs on items? |
| `galleries` | Do you want image galleries on items? |
| `external_navigation_urls` | Do you want to link to external URLs in your navigation? |
| `no_index` | Do you want to hide pages/news from listings (no\_index field)? |

## Site Identity

Every field [site.json](../src/_data/site.json) accepts, from the [site schema](../src/_lib/config/site-schema.js). The build fails on an unknown field, a missing required field, a value of the wrong type, a malformed or placeholder URL, or a placeholder name. Fields with a CMS label are editable in the CMS Site Configuration file.

| Field | Schema type | Presence | Default | CMS label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | **required** | None | Site Name | The site's name: page titles, the logo's alt text, feeds, and structured data. |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | None | Site URL | Canonical origin for absolute URLs: http(s), no trailing slash, query, or fragment. A deployment's \`SITE\_URL\` overrides it. |
| `description` | `string` | **required** | None | Site Description | Default meta description, and the organization description when meta.json gives none. |
| `logo` | `image` | optional | None | Logo | Header logo, a path under \`src/images/\` (for example \`/images/logo.svg\`), served as authored and linked to the home page. |
| `socials` | `object` | optional | None | Social Media Links | Footer social links, network name to URL. Each name needs an icon in \`src/\_data/social-icons.json\`; external URLs also become the organization's \`sameAs\`. |
| `socials.Github` | `string` | optional | None | Github |  |
| `socials.Facebook` | `string` | optional | None | Facebook |  |
| `socials.Instagram` | `string` | optional | None | Instagram |  |
| `socials.TikTok` | `string` | optional | None | TikTok |  |
| `socials.Google` | `string` | optional | None | Google |  |
| `socials.WhatsApp` | `string` | optional | None | WhatsApp |  |
| `socials.RSS` | `string` | optional | None | RSS |  |
| `cms_config` | `object` | optional | None | Not exposed | The CMS collections and features \`npm run customise-cms\` saved; change it with that command, not by hand. |

## Site Configuration

Every setting [config.json](../src/_data/config.json) accepts, from the [config schema](../src/_lib/config/config-schema.js). A site's config.json holds only the settings it changes; an omitted or `null` setting takes its default. The build fails on an unknown setting, a value of the wrong type, or a value outside the listed choices.

| Setting | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `horizontal_nav` | `boolean` | `true` | Any | Lay the main menu out across the header; \`false\` uses a left-hand menu column. |
| `sticky_mobile_nav` | `boolean` | `true` | Any | Keep the header pinned to the top of the screen on mobile. |
| `collapse_menu` | `string` | `"mobile"` | `mobile`, `always`, `never` | Where the menu folds behind a toggle button. Without JavaScript the menu stays expanded. |
| `language_switcher` | `string` | `"footer"` | `footer`, `header` | Where the language switcher renders on a site with more than one language. |
| `show_breadcrumbs` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Render a breadcrumb trail (and its BreadcrumbList JSON-LD) on every page but the home page; a page opts out with \`no\_breadcrumbs\`. |
| `navigation_content_anchor` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Append \`#content\` to internal menu, breadcrumb, and listing links so they land past the header. |
| `nav_thumbnails` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Show a thumbnail beside each nested (dropdown) menu entry that has one. |
| `enable_theme_switcher` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Compile every prebuilt theme into the stylesheet and render a switcher that lets visitors choose one. |
| `placeholder_images` | `boolean` | `true` | Any | Give a page with no thumbnail or gallery image a generated placeholder thumbnail. |
| `list_item_fields` | `array<string>` | `["thumbnail","link","date","subtitle"]` | `thumbnail`, `link`, `date`, `subtitle` | Which parts of an item a collection listing renders, in order. |
| `search_collections` | `array<string>` | `["news","pages","guide-pages","guide-categories"]` | Any | Collection tags whose pages the static search indexes; a page opts out with \`no\_index\`. |
| `homepage_footer_markdown` | `string` | `null` | Any | Markdown rendered in the footer of the home page only. |
| `linkify_urls` | `boolean` | `true` | Any | Turn bare URLs and email addresses in page text into links. |
| `externalLinksTargetBlank` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Open external links in a new tab (\`target="\_blank"\` with \`rel="noopener noreferrer"\`). |
| `phoneNumberLength` | `number` | `0` | Any | Digit count of the phone numbers to turn into \`tel:\` links; \`0\` turns phone linking off. |
| `screenshots` | `object` | `{}` | Any | Post-build page screenshots: \`enabled\` and \`autoCapture\` switch capture on; \`collections\` or \`pages\` choose the pages; \`outputDir\`, \`port\`, \`viewport\`, \`timeout\`, and \`limit\` tune the run. |
| `disable_liquid_cache` | `boolean` | `false` | Any | Turn off Liquid template caching while debugging templates. |

## Themes

Edit [theme.scss](../src/css/theme.scss), browse the theme files in [src/css](../src/css/), or preview and export a theme at `/theme-editor/` on the running site.

Consult the [Sass defaults](../src/css/_variables.scss) and [breakpoints](../src/css/_breakpoints.scss) rather than copying their values into another reference. Prefer theme overrides over changes to core styles.
